// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1915): React.memo(Image) and memo(Image). Not used in src today but a plausible
// form for a later picture component. Neither sets the prop.
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Image } from 'react-native';
const Still = React.memo(Image);
const Quiet = memo(Image);
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Still source={{ uri }} />
      <Quiet source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
